title: Borodin–Kostochka conjecture
statement: Borodin–Kostochka conjecture · 1977. Every graph of maximum degree Δ at least nine satisfies χ ≤ max(Δ − 1, ω).

counterexample.description: A connected graph on at most 18 vertices with maximum degree nine, no 9-clique, and no proper 8-coloring. Exact clique and bounded-colorability searches verify the refutation.
